LanguageData.Shell_BlasterSmoke.label: Blaster Screen Shell
LanguageData.Shell_BlasterSmoke.description: A smoke shell loaded with special particles. On impact it produces a charged-particle field that triggers charged munitions to burn out in mid-air, making it the perfect countermeasure against mechanoid legions or the megacorps and stellar empires of the midworlds. It is not common on the rim, however - not only because those who need it usually cannot produce it, but because it cannot intercept bullets from conventional firearms.

LanguageData.DMS_PerimeterScanner.label: perimeter scanner
LanguageData.DMS_PerimeterScanner.description: A scanner capable of detecting invisible creatures. The device raises an alarm when it detects the presence of psychically invisible objects within its radius.

LanguageData.DMS_ThermalBreacher.label: thermal breaching charge
LanguageData.DMS_ThermalBreacher.description: A single-use directional thermal breaching charge designed for cutting through heavy security doors and for anti-materiel use. When activated it produces a violent stream of superheated metal, focused on the contact point through a shaped nozzle. Within seconds it burns a channel through the surface of most industrial-grade alloys.\n\nBecause the reaction is extremely unstable, the device can only be used once. The operator must withdraw to a safe distance immediately after deploying it to avoid injury from high-temperature spatter and vaporized metal.
